claims.text: CSF tubes: 1 cell count and differential; 2 glucose and protein; 3 Gram stain and culture; 4 cell count and differential plus special studies.
claims.quote: T1: cell count + differential - T2: glucose + protein - T3: Gram stain + culture - T4: cell count + differential + special studies

claims.text: CSF add-ons: viral culture and HSV PCR; for cryptococcus, India ink or serum antigen (immunocompromised); for mycobacteria, acid-fast stain.
claims.quote: add-ons: viral culture - HSV PCR - latex agglutination, counter-immunoelectrophoresis (CIEP) (partially treated) - cryptococcal: India ink or serum antigen (immunocompromised) - mycobacteria: acid-fast stain

claims.text: Normal CSF: WBC < 5, RBC < 5, protein 15-45 mg/dL, glucose 50-80 mg/dL, clear.
claims.quote: normal: WBC <5 - RBC <5 - protein 15-45 mg/dL - glucose 50-80 mg/dL - clear

claims.text: Bacterial: high WBC, mostly neutrophils (about 80%); protein up, glucose down.
Viral: high WBC, mostly lymphocytes and monocytes; protein normal or up, glucose normal.
claims.quote: viral: ↑WBC mostly lymphocytes + monocytes - protein nl or ↑ - glucose nl

claims.text: SAH: yellow-orange xanthochromia of the centrifuged supernatant; RBC > 5000, visible < 2 h from onset.
claims.quote: SAH: xanthochromia of centrifuged supernate (yellow-orange) - RBC >5000 visible <2 h from onset

claims.text: Xanthochromia forms at about 12 h and lasts 2-3 weeks; blood persists in tubes 1 and 4.
claims.quote: xanthochromia: forms ~12 h - lasts 2-3 wks - persistent blood in tubes 1 + 4

claims.text: Joint fluid tests: cell count and differential, crystals under polarized light, Gram stain and culture, glucose and protein.
claims.quote: tests: cell count + differential - crystals (polarized light) - gram stain + culture - glucose/protein (infl/septic)

claims.text: Septic clues: glucose < 50% of serum; culture often positive (Gram stain positive in about 1/3).
claims.quote: septic clues: glucose <50% of serum - culture often + (gram stain + ~1/3)

claims.text: Crystals: MSU means gout, CPPD means pseudogout; crystals don't exclude a septic joint.
claims.quote: crystals: MSU = gout, CPPD = pseudogout - crystals ⍉ exclude septic

claims.text: Septic until proven otherwise: WBC > 50,000 with PMN > 75%.
claims.quote: interpret: septic unless proven otherwise when WBC >50,000 + PMN >75%
